notes.title: Update Information Ver. 1.0.0.4 (2016-10-6)
notes.content:
The following bug fixes were made:

- A bug in which the game would sometimes stop when attempting to start the game by using borderless window mode in Windows 10 has been fixed.
- Fixed other minor bugs.

notes.content:

notes.title: 更新內容 Ver. 1.0.0.1 Details (2014.09.02)
notes.content:
修正以下問題。

【修正的問題內容】

在開啟遊戲後，啟動環境設定以及Facebook認證時，文字是亂碼的問題。
於武將名鑑中，使用原本不應存在的篩選條件後，便會中止遊戲的問題。
無法將Facebook貼文機能設定為「有效」的問題。

------------------------------------------------------------------
Update details for Ver. 1.0.0.1

The following issues have been fixed.

The launch configurations and Facebook authentication windows having garbled text.
Game freezes in the officer listings (武將名鑑) when search parameters that should not exist are used.
Being unable to set the Facebook posting function to 'valid.'
